chapter: Starting out in New Orleans and Chicago
title: Sitting in with Bebe Ridgley's band as a New Orleans teenager
summary: As a teenager Williams was fetched to sit in with William Ridgley's Tuxedo band. Ridgley encouraged him in music and gave him clarinet lessons.
